# Loadout

> Directory of AI tools for vibe coders and builders, ranked by use case. Updated 2026-10-15. Machine-readable data: https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/tools.json (public, free to use with attribution).
## Categories
- [AI Code Editors & IDEs](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/categories/editors.html)
- [App Builders (Prompt-to-App)](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/categories/builders.html)
- [Coding Agents](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/categories/agents.html)
- [Agent Frameworks](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/categories/frameworks.html)
- [Deploy, Hosting & Backend](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/categories/backend.html)
- [Design-to-Code](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/categories/design.html)
- [AI APIs & Models](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/categories/models.html)

## Data
- [tools.json](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/tools.json): categories, tools (id, name, category, description, bestFor, pricing, url, verified), useCases, newReleases
- [llms-full.txt](https://itsjsimpson.github.io/loadout/llms-full.txt): full content in one file
